cause: Training/serving skew on a transformation. The training pipeline applied a log1p transform to f2 (train_f2 = log(1 + raw)), while the online serving path served the raw untransformed value. Verified by joining both feature groups on entity_id in the offline store: f1, f3, f4, f5 match exactly for all 200 shared entities (mean abs diff = 0), whereas f2 diverges (mean abs diff = 7.73) with the exact relationship serve_f2 = exp(train_f2) - 1 (e.g. e^0.96481-1=1.624, e^3.660053-1=37.863). Serving is missing the log1p transformation that training applied to f2.
